name: Marimekko textile set
about: Marimekko is a Finnish design brand known for bold, colorful prints. Its fabrics are a classic piece of Helsinki's design scene.
tip: Check the country of manufacture on each product, as it varies by item.

name: Iittala glassware
about: Iittala is a Finnish glass and tableware brand with a long design history. Its simple, clean shapes reflect Finnish design.
tip: Check the country of manufacture for each product, as it differs by item.

name: Moomin mug
about: Moomins are characters from Finnish children's books by Tove Jansson. Moomin mugs are a popular and easy-to-carry gift from Finland.
tip: The Moomin Shop and Stockmann both carry these mugs, so compare options in each.
